system.description:
You can summon forth a great cloud of inky, smothering darkness that muffles sound and slows movement. Expend a Blood Trait, and an approximately 10-foot diameter cloud forms anywhere you wish within 50 feet. If you concentrate, the cloud can move at a walking pace. Nocturne lasts for one scene or until you dispel it.

Anyone inside the cloud gains the Negative Trait Clumsy. Anyone within the cloud, other than the caster or someone able to see through Obtenebration, is two Traits down in any challenges and must undergo automatic retests if they succeed at anything. Heightened Senses and Witness of Darkness each remove one penalty Trait, though the automatic retest remains. Mortals with five or fewer current Physical Traits may be smothered as with Shadow Play.
